sources.locator: Written teaching sections Distance/Angle/Gaze; Viewing is active meaning-making; Teaching viewing not testing noticing

sources.criteria: Specific visible feature + plausible contextual effect + text/image evidence; alternative supported readings allowed.

sources.locator: Welcome to Country; Acknowledgement of Country; local Land Council advice

sources.criteria: Distinguish roles; use verified source; ask local hosts rather than infer local rules.
sources.transfer: Original school-event role comparison using supplied directions; no simulated cultural ceremony or invented language/protocol.
sources.limits: ABC Education Marcia Ella-Duncan page inspected first: actual who/when prompts visible but no transcript; media not played and answers not inferred from it. sources.locator: Full written Shelby Garlick transcript; Things to think about1–4
sources.observed: First-person introduction/earlier view, dated ordered events, sensory details, reflection and changed attitude. Questions ask autobiography/purpose, event order, sensory effect and another viewpoint.
sources.criteria: Use first-person self-experience/context and ordered event evidence; distinguish personal account from universal fact or a generic first-person fiction cue.
sources.transfer: Original calm school-experience fictional autobiographical model labelled as such, with complete events and reflection; no flood/advice/trauma content copied.
sources.limits: Years7–8 teacher reference, not imported student demand. Transcript read only, no historical verification or actual audio; source grammar slips not reused.
